reason: Example: f(z)=z+mu zbar is a homeomorphism with explicit inverse, orientation-preserving, f_z=1, f_zbar=mu, mu_f=mu, K_f=(1+|mu|)/(1-|mu|); the unit circle maps to the ellipse with semi-axes 1+-|mu|, whose axis ratio is K_f (eccentricity was the wrong invariant and is not claimed); the annulus modulus interval follows from the distortion lemma; the map is K_f-quasiconformal on every domain.
